name: io.github.diegoperezg7/mcp-guard-scan
title: mcp-guard
description: Security scanner for MCP servers: tool poisoning, shadowing, permissions, secrets, transport.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GUARD_ALLOW_STDIO
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to add scan_stdio_server, which starts the command it is given

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GUARD_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let scan_server reach local and private addresses, over http too

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: pino log level; logs go to stderr
